name: Schools
title: Bright Hill Academy: how a school runs its fees and its gate on Taskiem
blurb: One term at Bright Hill Academy in Ikorodu, Lagos: setting up the school's people, its classes and terms, its students and fees, invoicing the term, getting paid, chasing what is owed, resumption day at the gate, the daily close, and starting next term. Taskiem runs the school's work beside the chats the school already has with its parents and staff. Episode 0 shows the whole term; Episodes 1 to 10 teach each part.
card_sub: A term at Bright Hill Academy: fees, payments, the gate and the close.
cta_sub: Taskiem works alongside your chats: fees, payments, staff and the gate, taken care of.
